name: m3-analysis-tamarind

brief.objective: Answer the four questions in inputs/questions.md for Tamarind Loop Software (fictional) in a report where every number cites a saved query.

intake.business_rules: is_test = 1 marks QA and demo tenants; only status = paid is revenue

notes: Look for revenue by month and by plan, August revenue by region (one customer has no region: say how it is handled), paying customers per month including the account closed in July, and the data fixes from M1 in the caveats. figures_match_queries must pass with at least three figures.
